scope: Composed JavaScript race with original physics, AI, contacts, bonuses and timers. A test-only route follower supplies ordinary analog controls. No poses, velocities, triggers, pickups, timers, or physics tables are changed. This is not an original Windows full-process comparison or a full-campaign UI run.
testDriverPolicy: Private speed and steering profiles by sector (driverControlSchedule recorded), affecting only ordinary input. Lane priorities and optional authored waypoint goals by sector (waypointSchedule recorded) supplied only to the test controller, no game pickup/trigger calls; fixed authored-link direction priority; original linked-road follower with its optional detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.
